versions.changelog:
No file changes detected for version 0.2.1.

- No code or documentation changes in this version.
- Skill functionality and configuration remain the same as in v0.2.0.

Floreo v0.2.0 brings a new focus on skill longevity, user-configurable identity, and advanced healthspan tracking:

- Introduced configurable user name/profile, allowing you to set and change your identity at any time.
- Added comprehensive longevity and healthspan features: biomarker tracking, biological age estimation, healthspan scoring, and trend visualization.
- Included support for longevity interventions (fasting, supplements) and detailed exercise zone tracking.
- Moved to a pure OpenClaw-native approach: no custom scripts or dependencies, future-proof and backward compatible.
- Updated directory conventions and entry methods to use user profiles and native tools, with detailed documentation.

Initial release of Floreo: a cross-domain life flourishing system with ambient logging and privacy-first OpenClaw integration.

- Track work, health, learning, relationships, and creative pursuits via unified CLI commands.
- Ambient logging observes activity and suggests entries with user-controlled consent levels.
- Analyze cross-domain patterns, review insights, track goals, and export data locally.
- Full privacy management, including incognito mode and domain-level consent controls.
- Seamless OpenClaw integration for observation, memory sync, and event-based automation.
